description:
This set includes seven loose tourmaline gemstones with a total weight of 2.3 carats. The stones feature a variety of colors including pink, green, and yellow, and are cut in oval and rectangular faceted shapes. These natural tourmalines are presented without any metal settings. They are suitable for collectors or custom jewelry projects.
Please Note
Gemstones are tested using a Presidium Gem Tester. This tester cannot differentiate between manufactured and natural stones.
Gram weight includes materials and components of the entire item including stones unless noted.
Refer to photos for any additional markings that may be present.
High-end designer items are authenticated before listing.
Expect items to have normal wear from use. Items may require cleaning.
Jewelry pieces present in collection lots may have unspecified minor flaws.
Descriptions are made by individuals who may not have expertise specific to this type of item, in consultation with local and Internet resources. Shoppers are cautioned to evaluate items based upon their own resources. No guarantee of authenticity is implied unless specifically stated.
How Photography Affects Size Perception
Macro (extreme close-up) photography is heavily utilized in jewelry listings, enabling viewers to examine pieces in larger-than-life detail. An accurate understanding of the actual sizes of these pieces cannot be deduced using photos alone. It is important that the bidder takes close note of the measurements and weights to determine actual sizes.
About Gemstone & Metal Testing
Gemstones are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester. Goodwill of the Olympics & Rainier Region is a member of the International Gem Society; however, as we are not certified gemologists, we cannot guarantee the authenticity of any gemstone unless otherwise stated. Gemstone identification information is provided for your reference and consideration in bidding; no guarantee is implied.
Pearls are tested with a check for grittiness to detect nacre irregularities. We are generally unable to specify pearl types and characteristics; they may be cultured, wild, freshwater or saltwater pearls. Coral may be natural or dyed; most of our coral listings include dyed pieces.
Metals including Gold, Silver, and Platinum are tested using an XRF precious metal analyzer, the Niton XL2 by Thermo Scientific, unless explicitly noted otherwise. XRF (X-ray fluorescence) analysis is a non-destructive testing method able to determine an item's elemental composition. Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. Some jewelry may contain non-precious metals in clasps or findings, causing parts of the piece to respond to a magnet.
Collections
We are not able to answer questions about or provide condition descriptions for specific pieces present in collections of jewelry sold for jewelry making and crafting purposes, or in grab bags. Many pieces have unspecified condition issues. Please view provided photographs to determine general contents. No part of such groupings may be returned for any reason.
Condition descriptions for pieces present in scrap lots are not available and many pieces may have unspecified condition issues. Flaws may include missing stones, broken clasps, broken chains, bent or dented metal, repairs, and other damage. We are not able to answer questions about or provide condition descriptions for specific pieces present in scrap lots.
All items are sold as-is.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties is not responsible for items that are lost or stolen after the carrier confirms delivery. Items marked as delivered to the address provided become the responsibility of the buyer. Any delivery concerns must be directed to the shipping carrier.
Please verify your shipping address prior to placing your order! We are unable to stop, change, or redirect any shipments once the order has been shipped!
Orders typically ship within
5 business days
after payment clears (excluding weekends and holidays).
All shipments are sent
via FedEx only
, following FedEx packaging standards.
Orders over $100 require signature confirmation upon delivery.
Combined Shipping
Items that are not eligible for combined shipping are determined, at our discretion, to pose a risk of damage if shipped together.
Requests for combined shipping must be submitted
before payment
via a customer service ticket.
Once payment is completed, orders
cannot be modified or combined
.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
ART with glass is not eligible for combined shipping regardless of whether or not the system lets you combine them!
NOTE:
It is buyers' responsibility to evaluate whether or not the items could be safely combined! The system may "LET" you combine items, but should you combine a 13 LB bowling ball with a 2 LB vase?
Buyer will be responsible for damages of combined shipping items.

description:
Set of 3 Vintage Hemingray 42 and Whitall Tatum Glass Insulators
This set includes three vintage glass insulators used for telegraph or power lines. It features two Hemingray-42 insulators, one in aqua blue glass and one in clear glass, both embossed with branding and model numbers. The set also includes one Whitall Tatum Co. insulator in light blue aqua glass with embossed markings. Each insulator has ridged designs and domed tops characteristic of early to mid-20th century utility glassware. These pieces show minor wear consistent with vintage use and are suitable for collectors interested in historical or decorative items.

Combined Shipping Policy:

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

cannot be adjusted or discounted
.

The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Description

Crafted on canvas and presented in a sturdy, well-constructed frame, the back reveals a stamp indicating "Hecho en Mexico." Overall, this piece is in used, visible vintage condition with some minor marks and wear on the surface and frame, as shown in images. Perfect for those seeking a striking, character-filled artwork with traditional charm and a story to tell

Assorted Mineral and Crystal Specimens Quartz Geode Points Polished Stone 6x6
Collection of assorted mineral and crystal specimens including a large white quartz geode with crystalline interior, several quartz points with iridescent surfaces, a rough beige stone, a polished reddish-brown stone, and a geode slice with a shimmering surface. Most pieces are natural and unpolished, featuring clear crystal formations and slight golden inclusions. Condition is good with minor natural imperfections typical of mineral specimens. No brand or manufacturer markings present. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or metaphysical purposes.
